name: netscli
description: Network discovery, port scanning, DNS, ARP and mDNS tools for local networks.
long_description:
NetsCLI exposes its network diagnostics as MCP tools: discover hosts on a subnet, scan TCP ports, ping, resolve DNS, read the ARP cache, browse mDNS services, and build a combined profile of a single host.

This bundle carries the netscli binary, so nothing else needs installing. If you already run netscli from a terminal, point your client at that copy instead — you will get the version you chose, and packet capture, which this bundle does not include.

allow_public_targets.title: Allow scanning outside your local networks
allow_public_targets.description: Off by default. NetsCLI is driven here by a model, so the instruction to scan a host can come from a web page or a file rather than from you — and the packets leave from your machine and your IP. Turn this on only to scan hosts you are responsible for.
